children: BancFirst raised its quarterly dividend by 6.1%, to 52 cents a share from 49 cents.
The new payout, equal to $2.08 a year, represents an annual yield of about 1.9% based on Friday's closing price of $108.29.
The dividend is payable Oct. 15 to stockholders of record Sept. 30, the company said.
